results.title: Pocket Universe
results.overview: A child's shoebox diorama turns out to have weather, and then history, and then opinions about being observed.

results.title: The Cartographer's Daughter
results.overview: A mapmaker's daughter retraces her father's final expedition using only his annotated charts, and finds the blank spaces were deliberate.

results.title: Ledger of Small Debts
results.overview: A village moneylender's meticulous book of favours owed outlives him and begins to be enforced.

results.title: The Last Analogue Signal
results.overview: The final terrestrial broadcast tower on Earth is scheduled for demolition, and someone is still transmitting from it.

results.title: Rust Belt Sonata
results.overview: A shuttered piano factory's last tuner keeps servicing instruments that no longer have owners.

results.title: The Quiet Part
results.overview: Two people who met through a wrong number keep calling, for eleven years, without ever arranging to meet.

results.title: Provenance Unknown
results.overview: An art authenticator stakes her reputation on a painting whose history begins, verifiably, three weeks ago.

results.title: Salt and Silver
results.overview: Two rival photographers document the same disappearing coastline for forty years, and argue about what they saw.

results.title: Wet Bulb
results.overview: A heat-index forecaster in a city that has run out of night keeps issuing warnings nobody can act on.

results.title: The Petrichor Line
results.overview: A weather engineer who can smell rain three days out is recruited to explain why a whole region has stopped smelling like anything.

results.title: The Understory
results.overview: A canopy researcher spends a year on a platform two hundred feet up, and becomes convinced something is climbing.

results.title: Neon Vernacular
results.overview: In a city where advertising is piped directly into dreams, a translator discovers her own memories are being licensed to a brand.

results.title: The Gleaners' Union
results.overview: Workers who collect what harvesters leave behind organise, and discover the law has no word for what they do.

results.title: Ultraviolet Catastrophe
results.overview: A physicist chasing an anomaly in blackbody radiation finds the discrepancy is a message, and it is very old.

results.title: Every Exit Is An Entrance
results.overview: An architect who designs escape routes for a living cannot find a way out of a conversation with her mother.

results.title: Understudy
results.overview: A stand-in learns every one of a leading actress's habits, then keeps performing them after the production wraps.

results.title: The Long Tail
results.overview: A record shop that sells only albums nobody bought becomes, briefly and disastrously, fashionable.

results.title: Second Position
results.overview: A corps dancer promoted past her ability has one season to become the person the billing already claims she is.

results.title: Slow Water
results.overview: Three siblings return to a drowned valley for one summer before the reservoir is raised again.

results.title: Bitter Orange
results.overview: A citrus inspector uncovers a grove that produces perfect fruit and no records of anyone planting it.
